theme: 基金·基金经理：刘彦春在管基金、任职时长与管理规模变迁，切换谢治宇及兴证全球同公司规模对比
question: 感觉他这两年盘子缩了不少，往回看，2024年末的时候他的在管总规模是多少？
first_sql: SELECT t1.PSN_NAME AS `基金经理`, t2.REPORT_DATE AS `报告期`, ROUND(SUM(t2.NET_VALUE) / 100000000, 2) AS `在管总规模(亿元)` FROM FUND_AND_MANAGER_MAPPING t1 INNER JOIN FUND_ASSET_ALLOCATION t2 ON t1.FUND_HCODE = t2.FUND_HCODE WHERE t1.PSN_NAME = '刘彦春' AND t1.BEGIN_DATE <= '2024-12-31' AND (t1.END_DATE IS NULL OR t1.END_DATE >= '2024-12-31') AND t1.HISVALID = 1 AND t2.REPORT_DATE = '2024-12-31' AND t2.HISVALID = 1 AND t2.NET_VALUE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t1.PSN_NAME, t2.REPORT_DATE
final_sql: SELECT t1.PSN_NAME AS `基金经理`, t2.REPORT_DATE AS `报告期`, ROUND(SUM(t2.NET_VALUE) / 100000000, 2) AS `在管总规模(亿元)` FROM FUND_AND_MANAGER_MAPPING t1 INNER JOIN FUND_ASSET_ALLOCATION t2 ON t1.FUND_HCODE = t2.FUND_HCODE WHERE t1.PSN_NAME = '刘彦春' AND t1.BEGIN_DATE <= '2024-12-31' AND (t1.END_DATE IS NULL OR t1.END_DATE >= '2024-12-31') AND t1.HISVALID = 1 AND t2.REPORT_DATE = '2024-12-31' AND t2.HISVALID = 1 AND t2.NET_VALUE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t1.PSN_NAME, t2.REPORT_DATE
